projects.title: Highlighted Projects
projects.1.desc: SoundCloud is one of my favorite websites because it allows users to stream music online and, more importantly, to create and share their own tracks. That’s why I decided to recreate its interface to challenge myself after completing the basic foundations of web development.
projects.2.desc: BraveSale E-Commerce Website is a mock e-commerce website that lets users browse, search, and purchase products online with features like a shopping cart, account management, and responsive. It's designed to simulate a real online shopping experience.
projects.3.desc: SpaceZone is a social networking website inspired by Facebook and Instagram. It simulates the core features of social media to help me understand how social media works in real life. The project also strengthens my skills in backend technologies and full-stack development.
projects.4.desc: LightBrave is a modern student management system with smart attendance tracking via QR codes. The system supports secure login, access authorization, and classroom management. The platform also provides reports and dashboards for admin, teachers, and students.
projects.5.desc: FlowersGiftNow is an trending online platform for fresh flowers and gifts, offering a modern responsive interface that makes browsing, ordering, and tracking effortless while enabling admins to efficiently manage products, orders, and promotions for a best shopping experience.
